design_philosophy.concept: Bloomberg Terminal meets modern editorial design. A serious, authoritative newsroom aggregator that emphasizes live data, high density, and stark contrast.
forbidden_elements: Soft, rounded 'SaaS' aesthetics (no heavy drop shadows, no soft glassmorphism)
core_elements: Void black and deep charcoal backgrounds
Signal Red and Warning Amber accents
Strict grids, 1px solid borders separating all content modules
Editorial serif headlines paired with monospace datestamps and tickers

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-serif font-black tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.article_headline: text-lg sm:text-xl font-serif font-bold leading-tight hover:text-accent_secondary transition-colors

layout_strategy.overall_structure: Mode B: 'Control Room' Grid. High density, 100% viewport width usage, sticky components for live feel.

regions.top_bar: Sticky at top, z-50. Houses the 'LIVE' indicator, clock, and react-fast-marquee headline ticker.
regions.sidebar_left: col-span-12 md:col-span-2 or 3. Sticky navigation, Country/Region filter chips, Category list.
regions.main_feed: col-span-12 md:col-span-6 or 7. Asymmetrical masonry or mixed-density bento grid (1 large hero article, followed by dense 2-col or list items).
regions.sidebar_right: col-span-12 md:col-span-3. Breaking news timeline, saved articles (bookmarks), quick stats.

layout_strategy.spacing: Dense internal padding (p-3, p-4) for widgets. Use border-collapse style layouts with 1px solid borders instead of floating cards.

article_card.style: Flat, sharp edges (rounded-none). Background #121212, 1px border #262626. No shadow.
article_card.hover_state: Border changes to #FFB000 or #52525B. Image thumbnail un-grayscales (from grayscale to grayscale-0).
article_card.image: max-h-48 w-full object-cover filter grayscale opacity-80 hover:grayscale-0 hover:opacity-100 transition-all duration-300
article_card.content_layout: Flex-col, gap-2, p-4. Metadata (mono) -> Headline (serif) -> Source/Flag chip (flex row).

filter_chip.style: px-3 py-1 text-xs font-mono border border-border text-text_secondary hover:text-text_primary hover:border-accent_secondary transition-colors cursor-pointer uppercase

live_indicator.style: Flex items-center gap-2 text-accent_primary font-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase

ticker.style: bg-accent_primary text-background_base font-mono font-bold py-1 border-y border-border

motion_and_interaction.hover_effects: Micro-interactions. Text color shifts, sharp border color changes. No bouncy transforms.
motion_and_interaction.live_updates: When auto-refresh hits (60s), new items flash briefly with a #1C1C1E background.
motion_and_interaction.accessibility: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent_secondary focus:outline-none on all interactive elements. aria-live regions for breaking news.

image_urls.description: Russian news website screenshot - use as placeholder for world news hero
USA globe focus with sticky note - use for US/Politics
Journalists and videographers gathering - use for global/press coverage
Data center servers - use for Tech/Business news

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust, real-time global news dashboard tailored for a serious, journalistic tone.

CRITICAL: Do NOT use standard Shadcn card components if they force rounded corners and shadows. Override borders to be sharp (rounded-none) and 1px solid. Emphasize a 'control room' terminal aesthetic.

CRITICAL: Do NOT use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings. You MUST use 'Playfair Display' for article titles/headers, 'IBM Plex Sans' for body UI, and 'JetBrains Mono' for all timestamps, tags, and tickers.
Integrate 'react-fast-marquee' for a top-level breaking news ticker.
Ensure the layout feels asymmetrical yet strictly grid-aligned, mimicking a high-end editorial site or Bloomberg Terminal.
Implement a 60-second auto-refresh polling mechanism for the RSS feeds, accompanied by a 'LIVE' ping indicator.
Implement `data-testid` on all filters, article cards, search inputs, and bookmark buttons for testing purposes.
